description.value: The SureStay by Best Western Rossland Red Mountain is a motel on Highway 3B at the edge of Rossland, a mountain town celebrated for Red Mountain Resort's skiing and trail riding. It offers free breakfast and a hot tub, making it a comfortable base for cyclists tackling the hilly terrain of the Kootenay Boundary region. As a Best Western-affiliated property it participates in the BWH Rewards loyalty program.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Best Western booking page confirms this is an active, bookable property at 1199 BC-3B (Highway 3B), Rossland, matching the OSM address. Website page metadata tags include 'free-breakfast' and 'free-high-speed-internet', with the latter corroborated by OSM's internet_access=wlan tag; descriptive text confirms breakfast service and a hot tub but makes no mention of bicycle-specific amenities. The website title reads 'SureStay Plus Rossland Red Mountain' rather than the OSM name 'SureStay', and the direct hotel phone number does not appear in the scraped content, so phone confirmation is not possible from this source alone.
concerns: Website title reads 'SureStay Plus Rossland Red Mountain' while OSM name field is simply 'SureStay' and official_name is 'SureStay by Best Western' — the 'Plus' brand tier designation is absent from OSM tags.

Hotel's direct phone number (+1-250-362-7364 per OSM) does not appear in the scraped website content; only the central reservations number is shown, so phone confirmation is not possible from this source.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, bookable motel confirmed via Best Western website; real property at the stated address in Rossland, useful overnight stop for touring cyclists on Highway 3B.

Early or packed breakfast.detail: Website amenity icons include 'free-breakfast'; body text states 'Enjoy a balanced and delicious breakfast with choices for everyone. Fill up on coffee before you head out for the day.'
